1 · Intro

When to use it.

Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) reports on live HCM data. You use it to check your area's people, assignments, and costing without opening records one at a time.

The Departmental Playbook gives HCMs a starting set of reports built for this work.

Use this whenYou need a list or check across your area, such as everyone's costing, rather than one person's record.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle BI. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Bad data in, bad data out. A report only reflects what was entered in Oracle.
  • Do not save changes over a shared report. Save your own copy in My Folders.
  • Open item: confirm where the Departmental Playbook lives in the catalog (folder path) and whether Vanderbilt exposes Reports and Analytics on a different menu.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: View Analytics, Reports, and Dashboards (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Where to Save Analytics and Reports (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Which Playbook report would you use to confirm costing for your area?

Q2You save a report in My Folders. Who can see it?

Q3A colleague sees more rows than you on the same report. Why?

Keep it handy.

HCM Academy job aid · Document Records & Reporting

Introduction to BI Reporting and the Departmental Playbook

Use when: You need a list or check across your area, such as everyone's costing, rather than one person's record. · System: Oracle BI (OTBI)

  1. Open Reports and Analytics (Navigator > Tools > Reports and Analytics).
  2. Know the folders: Shared Folders for official reports, My Folders for yours.
  3. Search or browse to the report, then click its name to open it.
  4. Use the Departmental Playbook costing reports.
    • HCM Assignment Cost Allocation Plan
    • HCM Element Cost Allocation Plan
    • HCM Cost Allocation Verification Plan
  5. Expect to see only the people your security allows.

Watch-outs

  • Bad data in, bad data out. A report only reflects what was entered in Oracle.
  • Do not save changes over a shared report. Save your own copy in My Folders.
  • Open item: confirm where the Departmental Playbook lives in the catalog (folder path) and whether Vanderbilt exposes Reports and Analytics on a different menu.
